//: Copy to perf/corpus.local.json and edit. That file is gitignored ON PURPOSE:
//root: the paths below name files on your machine, and real dictionaries carry
//names: customer identities that must never reach this public tree. Anything not
//absent: filled in is reported as an absent role rather than silently skipped.

files.sldd-zip-entries: a zip-spelled .sldd with MANY entries (entry-count dominated)
files.sldd-zip-values: a zip-spelled .sldd with FEW entries but LARGE values
files.sldd-json-entries: the json-text spelling of the entry-count-dominated one
files.sldd-json-values: the json-text spelling of the value-size-dominated one
files.sldd-refs: a .sldd that actually carries Dictionary References (not empty)
files.sldd-oversize: a .sldd past V8's max string length, if you have one
files.slx-large: a .slx whose blockdiagram.xml inflates to several MB
